name: Sahel insurgency
value: JNIM pressure in Mali, Burkina; no city falls
summary: ACLED reports JNIM drone attacks and movement controls in Mali and pressure on Burkina towns; no major city has fallen
state: ACLED's Sahel updates to 4 Nov describe JNIM increasingly using drones against villages and controlling civilian movement in Mali, and encroaching on towns and transport hubs in Burkina Faso, including attacks on WFP. It also reports JNIM attacks on mining sites along the Mali–Guinea border (8 Oct). Searches on 10 Nov found no fall of a capital or major city and no mass-casualty spread to coastal states, though recent reporting is thin.
for_you: The insurgency affects travel and trade across Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger. FCDO advises against all travel to most of these countries.
rubric_hit: Sustained insurgency at current levels; no capital blockade success or coastal-state mass-casualty attacks
why: Jihadist groups control growing territory across Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger, driving displacement and coastal-state spillover.
drivers: JNIM/IS-Sahel offensives, juntas, Russian forces, blockades, coastal-state attacks.

rubric.alert: Blockade or fall of a capital or major city, or mass-casualty attacks spreading to coastal states.
